innovation_summary: tasklet-micro-agent-engine is a micro-agent execution engine that decomposes work into small bounded tasklets with explicit inputs and outputs — the opposite of the open-ended agent loop, trading autonomy for contractability. Its portfolio thesis is that agent reliability comes from shrinking the unit of work until each step has a declared signature that can be validated, retried, and attributed independently, which is what makes a swarm auditable instead of merely parallel. The domain atlas places it in the agent-orchestration cluster next to anthropic-agent-coordinator and manus-autonomous-web-agent, and it is the sole repository in the Tasklet family with an issue contract attached and a recorded priority of 'P1 implement runtime' — the estate's own assessment that the contract is defined but the runtime is not yet demonstrated.
